content_sections.heading: About the Agricultural Research Station, Chinapavani
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Officer In-charge, Agricultural Research Station, Chinapavani, Prakasam District, A.P-523115, of Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University. The post is engaged against the vacant sanctioned post of Scientist (GPBR), ARS, Podalakur, for the Agricultural Research Station, Chinapavani.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: One post of Research Associate (Plant Breeding) is to be filled. The duration is 11 months from the date of joining or until the regular post is filled, whichever is earlier. A Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture of 4 years duration from an ICAR accredited university with at least 55% marks or its equivalent grade. Master's Degree in Agriculture (Plant Breeding discipline) from an ICAR accredited university with at least 55% marks or its equivalent grade. Ph.D holder and/or two years of working experience in the relevant area of subject. Not exceeding 40 years for men and 45 years for women. The notice does not print an age cut-off date. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Three sets of Bio-data with latest passport size photo. Original certificates for verification. Two sets of attested copies of certificates and other documents, if any, along with the originals.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on a temporary and contract basis for 11 months from the date of joining or filling of the regular post, whichever is earlier. No TA/DA is admissible. The Associate Director of Research, RARS, Lam, Guntur has the right to alter any item in the notification or cancel it at any time as per the laid out procedures in vogue. For other details, contact the Officer Incharge, ARS, Chinapavani, on 9885138021 or at [email protected] .

rows.details: Walk-in interview notice for Research Associate (Plant Breeding)

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the ANGRAU Research Associate (Plant Breeding) walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 07.12.2026 at 10.00 AM at the office of Agricultural Research Station, Chinapavani, Prakasam District, A.P-523115.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is 1 (One) post of Research Associate (Plant Breeding).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A 4-year Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture and a Master's Degree in Agriculture (Plant Breeding discipline), both from an ICAR accredited university with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade. A Ph.D and/or two years of relevant experience is preferable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Not exceeding 40 years for men and 45 years for women.

faq.question: Q5. Who gets age relaxation and how much?
faq.answer: SC/ST/BC/EWS candidates get 5 years of relaxation, and persons with disability get 10 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs.61,000/- + HRA as applicable for Master's degree holders and Rs.67,000/- + HRA as applicable for Ph.D degree holders, per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the consolidated pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states the pay as Rs.61,000/- or Rs.67,000/- plus HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring three sets of Bio-data with a latest passport size photo, original certificates for verification, and two sets of attested copies of certificates and others, if any, along with the originals.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on a temporary and contract basis for 11 months from the date of joining or filling of the regular post, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is admissible.
